infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SafeWalk AI requires GPS location access during emergency activations to transmit coordinates to your emergency contacts and authorized 112 dispatchers.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SafeWalk AI requires microphone access for hands-free emergency voice detection and consented foreground audio evidence capture.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SafeWalk AI requires camera access for consented foreground emergency video capture.
